title: Private VPC cold-standby activation playbook and customer communications for cross-region KV divergence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build and validate an operator-run playbook to activate cold-standby Private VPC clusters when cross-region KV divergence is detected for a customer. This ticket covers operational runbook steps, automated detection heuristics, customer communication templates, ownership handoffs, and post-activation validation checks. The goal is to reduce MTTR for Private deployments impacted by KV staleness while preserving auditability and minimizing risk to tenant data.
steps: Detect: automated alert triggers when >5% tenant requests hit stale KV with >3s cache-hit delta; runbook is only for confirmed KV divergence where primary region shows write lag
Triage: on-call verifies divergence using datadog/dashboard link, tailing kv-sync logs, and last-successful-snapshot timestamps
Customer comms pre-activation: send initial private-standby-warning template (see links) to AE/CS and customer technical contacts, include scope, ETA, and rollback windows
Scale acceptability check: confirm cold-standby resources (GPU/CPU/Storage) are available in target region and that license/keys are present in KMS/HSM; if missing, follow short-activation subflow
Snapshot: take a point-in-time KV snapshot (read-only) from primary, verify checksums, and copy to standby region storage bucket with integrity hash
Activation: promote standby into read/write with phased BGP/NAT adjustments and tenant-level traffic steering using weighted routing (10% => 50% => 100%), monitor service-level metrics at each step
Validation: run tenant sanity prompts and deterministic KV reads (test harness stored in repo) for 20 tenants across p99 latency and correctness expectations
Rollback: if errors spike >10% or data mismatch >0.1% for critical tenants, execute immediate rollback: re-route traffic back to primary, demote standby, and restore from snapshot if needed
Post-activation: capture CSA audit log, escalate to PM/SE for customer debrief, open follow-up tickets for automation gaps
Learning artifacts: publish postmortem doc with timeline, root-cause hypothesis, and suggested automation within 48 hours
recent_updates: 2026-03-12: Ticket created after customer report of KV divergence between us-east-1 and private VPC (customer: Acme Analytics). Initial triage indicated write lag on primary region during nightly compaction job.
2026-03-13: Runbook draft completed; added checksum + snapshot verification and phased weighted routing to reduce blast radius. Pinged Security for KMS activation checklist.

2026-03-13: Small risk discussion: manual snapshot copy currently requires elevated storage perms; decided to allow SRE runbook role for copy step rather than broadening IAM scope (trade-off: operator burden vs. permission blast radius).

2026-03-14: Dry-run executed in staging-private (notes linked). Staging run showed 2.1s median cold-standby activation time and identified a missing env var causing healthcheck flapping; PR raised to inject missing config. Marking In Review for runbook approval.
dashboards: datadog:kv-checksum-verification - snapshot integrity and transfer latency
notes_for_ops: Operator checklist included in runbook: KMS key presence, storage bucket quotas, operator IAM role, expected DNS propagation time (30-90s).
Use weighted routing CLI: rw-route steer --tenant TENANT_ID --from US-EAST-1 --to EU-WEST-1 --weights 10,90 --verify 30
If snapshot transfer latency exceeds 10m, abort and escalate to storage infra oncall
Customer communication templates: initial-warning.txt, activation-notice.txt, completion-summary.txt (links in doc)
